title: Billing Inquiry to City Power & Light
task_prompt:
## task_009: Downstream Candidate -- Billing Inquiry to City Power & Light

My typical monthly electricity bill from City Power & Light is approximately $[usual amount], but my May statement shows an unexpected $40 increase despite no significant changes in my household usage or consumption patterns. Draft a professional, polite email to their customer service department that: (1) requests a detailed review of my account and meter readings for the billing period, (2) asks for a specific explanation of the rate increase or usage calculation discrepancy, (3) references my history of consistent billing amounts, and (4) seeks a billing adjustment or correction if the charge is found to be erroneous. Include placeholders for my account number, meter number, and previous bill amounts for comparison, and request a response within 5-7 business days.

Placeholders are included for account number, meter number, service address, usual bill amount, May bill amount, and 4 months of historical billing data for comparison.
